 if (a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)"'!=(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr): print('"'FAIL',args,'REF',repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr),'OUR',repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr)); return 1
 return 0

import subprocess,pathlib,sys,random,csv,io
random.seed(2); ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); ours=[sys.executable,'xsv_port.py']; p=pathlib.Path('probe')
def run(args):
 a=subprocess.run([ref,*args],capture_output=True); b=subprocess.run([*ours,*args],capture_output=True)
 return a,b
fail=0
for case in range(30):
 cols=random.randint(1,5); n=random.randint(0,12); heads=[f'h{i}' for i in range(cols)]
 vals=['', 'a','b','01','-2','1.5','3',' x ','x,y','q\"z']
 rows=[heads]+[[random.choice(vals) for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(n)]
 s=io.StringIO(newline=''); csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\\n').writerows(rows); f=p/f'r{case}.csv'; f.write_bytes(s.getvalue().encode())
 commands=[['count',str(f)],['headers',str(f)],['select',f'1-{cols}',str(f)],['slice','-s','2','-l','4',str(f)],['search','"'^[ab]'"',str(f)],['sort',str(f)],['sort','-R','--select',str(cols),str(f)],['fmt','-t','|',str(f)],['table','-c','4',str(f)],['stats','--everything',str(f)]]
 for args in commands:
  a,b=run(args)
  if (a.returncode,a.stdout,a.stderr)"'!=(b.returncode,b.stdout,b.stderr):
   fail+=1; print('"'\\nFAIL',args); print('REF',a.returncode,repr(a.stdout),repr(a.stderr)); print('OUR',b.returncode,repr(b.stdout),repr(b.stderr));
   if fail>=8: raise SystemExit
print('random failures',fail)
'@ | python -"
